finiteModels.limits: One literal populated image field, at most one supplied size/caption/alt field. Competing aliases including blank stay ambiguous. Same filename, width, caption and alternative text are all required. Unsupported embedded options stay ambiguous. A single supplied literal inline caption may transfer only with no competing native caption field. Current native magicword aliases are excluded from caption inference; unsupported options remain ambiguous. A call nested in another template has unproved owner semantics and remains explicitly ambiguous.

One nonnested literal table. Leading unmatched triple apostrophe on a header line only, optionally with the exact scope=col insertion. Existing payload/attributes/ref targets remain bound. A malformed style prefix is not projected.
All supplied literal DEFAULTSORT values must be byte-identical. Conflicting sequences remain ordered and cannot be collapsed by this model.

Exact active bare native category only, no sort key or protected/unknown parent. Complete remaining category/defaultsort inventory must equal the actual target. Original rendering equivalence is not claimed.
One native Page/Pages role with supplied literal numeric page/range, no NoPP override including blank. Exact page/range and every other citation role remain associated.
Unique publication Date role, literal YYYY/M with month 1..12 to YYYY-MM. Year/month precision retained, no invented day and no access/archive date inference.

Every owned cell remains attached to its row index, row attributes and ordered row cell count. Only entirely empty attribute-free native wiki |- row markers may be omitted; explicit HTML tr rows stay counted, including empty rows. Nested grid ancestry remains explicitly ambiguous.

Known native/local CS1 family only, one typed date role, complete citation association retained. Four exact Portuguese seasons, exact supplied month range/year without sorting, or month-initial full day. No inferred day, hemisphere, season-to-month conversion or partial access/archive date. Unequal competing aliases and explicit blanks preserve key/value precedence.

Only exact Carece de fontes data=Janeiro de 2011/lowercase pair; exact native caption-table terminal |- valign=top | bar; five native file namespace headers for complete literal supported-extension targets. All other table/template/caption bytes remain bound. No foreign namespace or caption-word inference.

Move one supplied full stop from after a direct complete native caption ref to before that same ref and insert one following word separator. Full projected media inventory must equal actual target. Ordered marker attributes/group/name/body associations must be identical; named selfcalls may use exactly one globally unique byte-identical full raw body on both sides, outside unknown/literal/bank/inherited contexts. No altered body/date/author/URL/group/name/marker order/file/alt/options/rest-caption waiver.

A literal pipe in an unbracketed bare ExternalLink AST node inside one of five native file namespaces separates image options. Split only that raw node, retaining URL and every later caption/reference node. Bracketed external links, dynamic tokens and foreign namespaces do not borrow this boundary proof.

A recognized collector consumes its selected group and resets that group named-reference registry. Retain source marker/body/name/group associations within each interval. Another group collector never clears this group. Same-interval raw-identical definitions may not become different raw source bytes, even when citation aliases would render alike. Unknown collector scope remains ambiguous.
Visit actual references inside heading title AST in source order. Preserve resolved source, name, group, body and marker order. This adds no automatic heading transformation or reference removal.

Join contiguous non-template AST source nodes before reading rich reference content. This preserves exact serialization and prevents incidental Text node splitting from inventing a space inside linktrail. Changed word, separator or target remains unequal.

One unique parameter2 is selected, including explicit blank, otherwise one unique parameter1. Only selected payload is traversed. Style/unknown/unused positional fields are never activated or discarded. Item/ref/content order stays exact.

Only current pinned native CS1 families and separately verified local forwarding aliases use the independent citation reader when nested in a rich value. Keep class, all populated roles, unknown fields, numbered associations, competing alias precedence and explicit blanks. Unknown/foreign/non-CS1 wrappers remain raw or ambiguous.

Unique native AuthorList-Last/EditorList-Last or distinct unstructured Authors field retains its complete literal personal-name prefix, including inverted names, initials and unchanged comma/semicolon text. Move only supplied terminal marker to typed display field. No person-list split, role conflation, institution inference or competing aliases/blanks. Native Authors remains distinct from AuthorList-Last.

Exact pinned local Citation needed/Fact/See also/Seealso/Ver também forwarding retains every argument. Native single-payload Azul is represented as exact blue Cor do texto, with source-proved terminal style punctuation only. Unknown fields, payload, target, color or order changes are not ignored.

One complete nonnested wikitable, no template/comment/native opaque child, and only adjacent bare attribute-free empty row markers. Retain every cell, explicit row, span, payload and order. No HTML row removal, span clamp or generic table normalization.

A standalone header line with only one quoted positive rowspan/colspan1..999 and literal supplied text may receive one cell separator. This intentionally changes the original grid and is never rendering equivalence. Every complete projected table/cell/row/span/attribute/payload must equal the actual target. Malformed extra attributes, other markup, protected/unknown owners are refused. Independently select only same-index complete candidate tables that match their full actual target; unchanged tables remain source-exact and do not authorize additional repairs.

Literal supported unique NSRW wrapper fields, exact fixed work/year/editor/location/publisher defaults, supplied wstitle/display and optional full public-domain attribution. Explicit English sister-project target and removal of imported tracking categories are declared. Unknown/duplicate/positional/dynamic fields, blank display, overridden bibliographic defaults and unsupported flags are refused. Exact complete target must be witnessed before projection.

Only an active attribute-free nameless self-closing ref or paired ref containing exclusively ASCII space/tab/CR/LF, outside native literal/unknown/collector/ref owners. Native Cite emits a no-content error. This declared invalid-syntax cleanup requires the entire remaining ordered binding/definition/group/list/pending-marker graph to equal the actual target. Names/groups/follow/details/unknown attributes/comments/nonempty contents are never ignored.

In addition to unique exact full body/group/name and complete marker/list graph, the independently projected top-level marker positions relative to every non-ref rich source payload must match the target. No removal of an earlier same-name marker before intervening prose may borrow a later adjacent redundant marker proof. Exact unchanged opaque body/group/name association inventories may satisfy the existing opaque-identity boundary only when all complete graph keys and marker-position windows match. Unrelated unresolved field semantics are not discarded if any opaque association changes. Crossed literal closing-reference boundaries remain ambiguous.

A literal closing ref token parsed inside a citation field or reference body, outside native opaque content, indicates parser recovery beyond a native boundary. Such cases remain separately counted as ambiguous even if unchanged. This never suppresses a new same-interval raw named-definition split or claims full validation.

Native-active references in code/quotation/poem/ordinary markup retain their source identity independently of writer protections. Collector reset is per exact native emitted group. Unknown owners or inherited rendering outside finite contracts remain explicitly ambiguous.

C0/C1/Unicode-edge or unproved named entities are never canonicalized using HTML5 or Unicode trim. Complete refs, partial supplied openings, native collectors and known emitter calls retain exact ordered source bytes. Template parameter entities are distinct from raw-ref attribute entities. Unchanged uncertain identities stay ambiguous, changed subsystem is failed. Native raw/comment examples are excluded.
One complete exact local inactive-link template following a bare HTTP URL is a separate native object. Preserve every URL and argument byte. No unknown/malformed/bracketed-link inference.

Exact first-letter-equivalent native R, Referências múltiplas and R/ref names only. Observe positions1..9, blank-aware group→grp→g precedence, literal template-argument identity and all page/quote presentation fields. Ordered resolved calls and per-group physical collector intervals remain bound. Unknown, dynamic, entity-bearing or attribute-scoped helper calls remain an exact uncertain reference-subsystem boundary, never inferred raw-ref entity equivalence. Writer protection is independent of native activation.

Only exact pinned native Refn/Nre/Efn and literal builtin tag-ref calls use finite unique literal name/group/body fallback, including the native named Nre grupo branch. Protected code/quotation scope remains active for native association. Competing aliases, duplicate or unknown fields, dynamic body content, uncertain identities and attribute-scoped emitters retain exact reference-subsystem bytes. Exact pinned Sfn/Sfnp/HarvRef/Sfnm/Sfnmp generated identity remains explicitly ambiguous when unchanged and failed if its whole reference subsystem changes. No generated-name or body guess, no arbitrary macro expansion and no template-argument entity decoding.

Only exact independent raw marker/group/name/body associations, full definition bytes, unchanged ordered call multiplicity, one final plain native default collector and an actual AST marker discrepancy under odd unclosed italic permit explicit ambiguity. No source semantics are passed, no raw name conflict, changed body, URL/label, group, collector window or marker is waived. The source-only removal of an ignored positive col field preserves that default-group collector contract, never full HTML equivalence.
